description: We are Team ZenoX from India: Bhagnesh Karmuk Raghav (Systems & Astropy Pipeline), Kshitij Vats (Spectral Analysis & IRSA APIs), Yuvika Rathore (Cosmic UI & JS9 Visualization), and Tanisha Shrivastava (Time-Domain Research & Guides). United by a passion for open science, we combined Python astrophysics and interactive web design to build ZenoX:SpherexView—making NASA's 102-band infrared sky accessible to all.
